outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative pseudocoloured time-lapse images of photoactivation experiments without any quantification or statistics, so replicate reporting is not required.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A)
Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively)
outputs.explanation: Panel B shows quantified fluorescence-recovery/relaxation curves fitted to a diffusion model, and the insets show averaged responses with visible error bars, indicating replicated measurements. However, the legend never states how many replicates (cells, nuclei, or independent experiments) were used to generate the averages or error bars, nor the type of replicate, so the n-number and replicate type are both missing.
